content:
name: Temporary WP-MVP-0005 reconcile only

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ops/wp-mvp-0005-reconcile-review

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: wp-mvp-0005-reconcile-only
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  reconcile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out product branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: wp/mvp-0005
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Merge canonical main and regenerate derived projections
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git fetch origin main
          set +e
          git merge --no-commit --no-ff origin/main
          status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            conflicts="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"
            test -n "$conflicts"
            while IFS= read -r path; do
              case "$path" in
                .eos/trace-edges.tsv|machine/*)
                  git checkout --theirs -- "$path"
                  git add -- "$path"
                  ;;
                *)
                  echo "Unexpected non-derived conflict: $path" >&2
                  exit 1
                  ;;
              esac
            done <<< "$conflicts"
          fi
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "chore(core): reconcile WP-MVP-0005 with canonical execution state"
          git push origin HEAD:wp/mvp-0005
